[element-doc-number]
=== `<doc-number>` Document Number

Gives the document-number part of the document’s standard designator; for example, for the designation “`ISO 9100`”, the `<doc-number>` would be the digits “`9100`”.

#### Usage/Remarks
This is the standard number for the document. Its typical content is a sequence of digits. The document number _does not_ include any part number or the year of publication.
